title: 第11章 有我在别怕第12章 即便是你错老公让你变成对的
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第11章有我在，别怕中餐厅，包厢。
纪瑾修被一群大佬围着说恭维的话，都希望从他这里得到合作机会。
他只静静听着，偶尔点点头，深邃的眉眼不露情绪，讳莫如深。
修长的手指偶尔在桌面上敲几下，神态慵懒矜贵。
直到陈特助慌忙进来，在他耳边低语：“夫人在隔壁餐厅，出事了。”
纪瑾修面色一沉，如冰山爆发，寒意凛冽。
“立刻过去。”
他起身，快步离开。
诸多大佬头一次看他如此紧张，不由一惊。
难不成，出什么大事了？
……
此时，唐凝被纪寒的自以为是气笑了。
“领证？”
唐凝笑完后，冷声嘲讽：“别说我们已经分手了，即便没分，纪寒，你觉得像你这种不干净的人，我还会要吗？”
她凉凉扫一眼纪馨宁，一个都不放过：“你们一个够蠢，一个够茶，垃圾归类凑一对正好。”
“我们走。”
唐凝拉着许雾离开。
纪寒面色顿时阴云密布，仿佛狂风暴雨即将来临。
“唐凝，你……你出手伤害我不够，还这么侮辱我和二哥。”
“你，你简直太过分了。”

纪馨宁仿佛受了极大的侮辱似的，低头哭出声来，一边假装擦眼泪。
眼看唐凝要走，朱厌忍无可忍：“纪少，这你都能忍？我可忍不了！”
说完他给唐凝的后膝盖踢了一脚。
扑通。
唐凝猝不及防，重重跪在地板上，仿佛膝盖骨都要被震裂。
这一震，加剧了刚才的腰伤，疼得她直冒冷汗。
“唐凝，你还好吗？”
许雾看她被欺负，气不打一处来，“你们太过分了，有这么欺负人的吗？”
“又是你在这碍手碍脚，给我滚开。”
朱厌就是趁机想修理一番唐凝，一脚踹向许雾。
唐凝见状。
情急之下，急忙抱住许雾，挡在她面前。
眼看这一脚就要踹向唐凝。
纪寒一怔，想出手阻止，纪馨宁装作头晕，倒在他身上进抓着他手臂。
“二哥，我头好晕，应该是刚才因为冷水冲头，受了寒。”
纪寒闻言，眼底的心疼骤然消散。
content_en:
Chapter 11: As long as I am here, don’t be afraid of Chinese restaurants and private rooms.
Ji Jinxiu was surrounded by a group of big guys saying compliments, all hoping to get cooperation opportunities from him.
He just listened quietly, nodding occasionally, his deep brows showing no emotion, and keeping secrets.
His slender fingers occasionally tapped on the table, with a lazy and dignified expression.
Until Special Assistant Chen came in in a hurry and whispered in his ear: "Madam is in the restaurant next door. Something happened."
Ji Jinxiu's face darkened, like an iceberg exploding, and it was freezing cold.
"Go there immediately."
He stood up and left quickly.
Many big bosses couldn't help but be surprised when they saw him so nervous for the first time.
Could it be that something big happened?
…
At this time, Tang Ning laughed angrily at Ji Han's self-righteousness.
"Get the certificate?"
After Tang Ning finished laughing, she taunted coldly: "Don't say we have broken up. Even if we are not, Ji Han, do you think I would still want an unclean person like you?"
She glanced at Ji Xinning coolly, not sparing any of them: "One of you is stupid, the other is stupid, it's just right for you to sort out the garbage."
"Let's go."
Tang Ning pulled Xu Wu away.
Ji Han's face suddenly became cloudy, as if a violent storm was coming.
"Tang Ning, you...you didn't hurt me enough, yet you insulted my second brother and me like this."
"You, you are simply going too far."
As if she had been greatly insulted, Ji Xinning lowered her head and cried, pretending to wipe her tears.
Seeing that Tang Ning was about to leave, Zhu Yan couldn't bear it anymore: "Mr. Ji, can you bear this? I can't bear it!"
After saying that, he kicked Tang Ning's back knee.
thump.
Tang Ning was caught off guard and knelt heavily on the floor, as if her kneecaps were about to be shattered.
This shock aggravated the waist injury just now, and the pain made her break into a cold sweat.
"Tang Ning, are you okay?"
Seeing her being bullied, Xu Wu was furious, "You guys have gone too far. Are there any bullies like this?"
"You're in the way again, get out of my way."
Zhu Yan took the opportunity to repair Tang Ning and kicked Xu Wu.
Tang Ning saw this.
In desperation, he hurriedly hugged Xu Wu and stood in front of her.
He was about to kick Tang Ning.
Ji Han was startled and wanted to stop him, but Ji Xinning pretended to be dizzy, fell on top of him and grabbed his arm.
"Second brother, I feel dizzy. It must be because of the cold water on my head just now."
When Ji Han heard this, the heartache in his eyes suddenly dissipated.
